notes: 19 wall hooks between the two pillars (bay 2 of the Memox wall rack), numbered left to right. The hook pitch is constant, so the row is split 19 ways. A slot is occupied when a bike's front wheel is at its hook or the bike leans on that hook (bikes 2 and 3 lean on the rack instead of hanging, they still take hooks 7 and 11). A handlebar reaching into a neighbouring slot does not occupy it. Hook 3 is hidden behind the bike hanging on hook 4 from this camera position: unknown (not used for training or scoring); counted 2026-10-31 on site.
